Only Cost Per Delivery is listed, so all three required guardrails are missing.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: must not increase.","citations":["guardrail-standards#eta-and-delivery-promise-changes"],"recommendation":"Add Delivery CSAT, Contact Rate, and Promise Accuracy as guardrails with explicit stop thresholds (and consider checkout conversion)."},{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Does not learn from EXP-014 result","detail":"The proposal says it follows EXP-014 but ignores that EXP-014 was concluded and not shipped. That experiment showed OTD gains came from relaxed promises, with conversion down 1.2%. The proposal does not address this learning and judges success on OTD alone.","evidence_quote":"Follows EXP-014, but only applies during storms rather than permanently.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-014-eta-buffer"],"recommendation":"Explicitly reference the EXP-014 outcome and judge success on Promise Accuracy and checkout conversion, not OTD alone."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Unsourced baseline and weather claims","detail":"The 78% storm OTD baseline is stated as fact without a source. The problem statement cites only a generic analysis name with no figures or link.","evidence_quote":"baseline 78%, target 88% within 8 weeks","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the data source and query or analysis for the 78% baseline, and link the weather impact analysis."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Short duration, no MDE/power, storm exposure issues","detail":"The test runs 1 week, under the 14-day minimum, with no MDE or power analysis. Storms are sporadic, so a 1-week window may yield few storm deliveries. Randomizing by customer may also leak across arms because the same drivers and orders share capacity.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by customer. Run for 1 week. Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Run at least 14 days (or until enough storm events accrue), state MDE and power, and use a randomization unit that avoids cross-arm leakage, such as zone or time block."},{"type":"NO_BASELINE_TARGET","title":"Guardrail has no numeric threshold","detail":"The Cost Per Delivery guardrail has no baseline, numeric stop threshold, or timeframe, so the breach policy cannot be applied. 'Must not increase' is not measurable.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: must not increase.","citations":["experimentation-standards#guardrail-breach-policy"],"recommendation":"Define baseline and numeric stop thresholds for every guardrail so the breach policy can be enforced."}]}
